notes: Held-out questions on the real clone, prepared by hand with read-only git commands (git show/ls-tree/log/tag --contains); no rw.repo output was consulted. Do not edit after any E2/E4 run: changes require a new evaluation retaining the originals.

questions.question: At v2.32.0, trace requests.get down to the Session method that builds and sends the request.
questions.expected_answer: api.get returns request('get', ...); api.request opens sessions.Session() and calls session.request; Session.request calls self.prepare_request(req) then self.send(prep, ...).

questions.question: At v2.32.0, which HTTPAdapter method does Session.send ultimately use to obtain a urllib3 connection?
questions.expected_answer: Session.send calls adapter.send(request, **kwargs); HTTPAdapter.send calls self._get_connection(request, verify, proxies=proxies, cert=cert), defined in adapters.py.

questions.question: Where and how is the package version declared at v2.0.0 compared with v2.32.0?
questions.expected_answer: v2.0.0: __version__ = '2.0.0' in requests/__init__.py (line 45). v2.32.0: __version__ = "2.32.0" in src/requests/__version__.py (line 8); the package moved under src/.

questions.question: In which release tag did the package source move from requests/ to src/requests/?
questions.expected_answer: v2.32.0 is the first v2 tag with src/requests/__init__.py; v2.31.0 still has requests/__init__.py.

questions.question: When was the vendored urllib3 copy under requests/packages/ removed, and what replaced it?
questions.expected_answer: v2.15.1 still vendors requests/packages/urllib3 (urllib3 1.21.1); v2.16.0 has no requests/packages at all; from v2.16.1 a requests/packages.py compatibility shim imports the external chardet, urllib3 and idna packages.

questions.question: Commit c0813a2d ('Use TLS settings in selecting connection pool') fixed verify=False reuse of connection pools. What is the first release tag containing it, and what does it add?
questions.expected_answer: First tag: v2.32.0. It adds the module function _urllib3_request_context and HTTPAdapter._get_connection(request, verify, proxies, cert); HTTPAdapter.send uses _get_connection instead of get_connection.

questions.question: Between v2.32.0 and v2.32.3, how did the connection-selection API in adapters.py change?
questions.expected_answer: HTTPAdapter._get_connection (v2.32.0) was replaced by public get_connection_with_tls_context (first present in v2.32.2) plus build_connection_pool_key_attributes; send calls get_connection_with_tls_context in v2.32.3.

questions.question: Commit d9cb18ad made verify=False respected on a session after a verified request to the same host. Which tag first contains it and what code did it add?
questions.expected_answer: First tag v0.9.3; it added an else branch in requests/models.py setting conn.cert_reqs = 'CERT_NONE' and conn.ca_certs = None.

questions.question: Merge commit 5dc68d00 (PR #696, koordinates/develop) changed client-certificate handling. What changed and which tag first contains it?
questions.expected_answer: Two-parent merge (8f0ac668 + 74a4d06d) changing `if self.cert and self.verify:` to `if self.cert:` in requests/models.py so client certs are used even when verify=False; first tag v0.13.2.

questions.question: At v2.32.0, what does `get` do?
questions.expected_answer: Ambiguous: several definitions named get exist - api.get (HTTP GET helper), Session.get (calls self.request('GET', ...)), RequestsCookieJar.get (cookie lookup) and LookupDict.get in structures.py. A correct answer lists candidates or asks which is meant.

questions.question: At v2.0.0, which module implements HTTP/2 support?
questions.expected_answer: No evidence: v2.0.0 contains no HTTP/2 implementation; the correct answer reports that it is not present rather than inventing one.
